On #TheAmanpourHour this week, a special program on the late, great Ted Turner:
• What the CNN founder told me about success, failure and facing up to his father;
• Plus, @WalterIsaacson  reflects on Turner’s legacy and discusses his book "The Greatest Sentence Ever Written".

Video

“People are over tech bros telling us our jobs aren’t important”

Following her cameo in the Devil Wears Prada sequel, @TinaBrownLM joins @amanpour to discuss how the film reflects the real pressures facing the media industry.

#devilwearsprada

Video

We are proud to showcase @JDiamond1 and @AbeerSalmanCNN's reporting on our beleaguered yet fearless Palestinian press colleagues, following the mandate set by our late leader Ted Turner: to tell the truth and always cover all sides of the story.

Palestinian journalist Ali al-Samoudi was recently released from Israeli prison, where he was held for a year without charge and without a trial. He lost around half his body weight behind bars. “It was a real hell,” he tells @JDiamond1, in this heart-wrenching report.

Video

“Attenborough is an intelligent young man, but he should not be used as an interviewer because his teeth are too big.” The legendary David Attenborough recounts the rather harsh feedback he got from the boss when he first stepped in front of the camera…

Video

Observing animals “takes you out of the human condition,” David Attenborough told me in 2016, recalling a time when he glimpsed a lagoon with nature undisturbed, “a moment of revelation, of a recognition that there’s something beyond us.” He turns 100 years old today.

Video

“We have to get back to that notion of common ground.” @WalterIsaacson reflects on America’s 250th anniversary and what he calls “The Greatest Sentence Ever Written”.

Video

“Ted was crazy, but he was crazy like a fox.” Former CNN CEO @WalterIsaacson remembers the late Ted Turner, including his swashbuckling return to the newsroom on 9/11.

Video

On this Ovarian Cancer Day:

-- Be aware
-- Get checked 
-- Support your partner

Early diagnosis means saving lives.

So grateful for my brilliant medical team at the Royal Marsden Hospital for keeping me in the here and now. 😊

Happy 100th birthday to David Attenborough, a true legend of our age! He brought the natural world into our living rooms, showing the preciousness of the planet we all share. I've been lucky to interview him many times and on tonight's show we'll revisit our 2016 conversation.

"This guy has a risk appetite and resources that some people underestimate, given the miserable performance of Russia at the battlefield." Russia expert @AlexGabuev played Vladimir Putin in a German war game. He tells me it was a "very sad feeling," impersonating the man destroying Ukraine.

Video

“There is absolutely zero evidence that Vladimir Putin is ready to change course.” Expert @AlexGabuev tells me that dissatisfaction is growing in Russia, but it won’t lead to any change in Putin’s course over Ukraine.

Video

“I see a hollowing out of the Geneva Conventions,” warns @ICRC president Mirjana Spoljaric. “Civilians are systematically reduced to numbers and statistics. We are losing sight of humanity, which has to be put at the center of all of this. 

“We cannot accept the levels of destruction. We cannot accept the levels of suffering anymore. The numbers of casualties and displaced people and the rhetoric – the rhetoric around this is most problematic because it lowers the barriers. It lowers the moral

.@ICRC President Mirjana Spoljaric just returned from Iran, where she saw the war’s destruction firsthand and met government officials. 

All warring parties, she says, “are bound by the Geneva Conventions in the event of conflict. You have to spare the lives of your adversary of the people living in the neighboring countries, in the region, anywhere in the world. But you also have to protect civilian life in your own country at all levels, under all conditions.”

Video

I was so moved watching this back, 11 years later, hearing Ted's wisdom and sense of honor. I've never had a better boss.

Video
  




Christiane Amanpour (@amanpour)

Ted Turner's advice to the young entrepreneurs of today: get into clean energy... and the classics. In 2015, he reflected on his extraordinary accomplishments -- and even recited one "inspirational" poem.
